inputs: master.csv row: market_cap,price (oe_yield + kline mcap reconstruction)
a_cashflow_annual.csv: ocf,capex + a_financials.csv: profit + a_dividends.csv: div_paid by fy (A)
models/<market>/<code>/raw/history.json: multi-year ocf,capex,net_income (convergence, optional — modeled stocks only)

lineage.source: Buffett 1986 owner earnings ( Berkshire annual report ) + Buffett 1984 $1-retained yardstick
lineage.note: 资本配置三问: 业主盈余 OE=ocf-capex / $1留存是否创出$1市值 / OE与利润的收敛轨迹

limits: maintenance capex DECLARED = full capex — conservative, understates OE for asset-light businesses
$1-retained usually None: snapshot klines span ~1.3y < 3y — never computed on a short window
model-history years carry no dividend field — multi-year retained would be approximated by net_income (overstatement, declared)
A/HK FY-annual cash flow vs interim profit — period mismatch declared on oe_vs_profit
红灯可否决，绿灯不构成买入理由
